input.overview: Zira rewards repeated target-bank completions, bonus multipliers, and the captive-ball lane. Complete the four lower drops to raise their awards and light the red and blue bumpers; pass all installed captive-ball switches for Extra Ball. Use the central targets to advance toward 3x, 4x, and 5x bonus. Repeatedly complete the seven upper drops to reach the tier that lights Special at the central red targets.
input.simpleOverview: Complete the four lower drops to build their awards and light the red and blue bumpers, then pass all installed captive-ball switches for Extra Ball. Hit the central targets until 3x, 4x, or 5x bonus is lit. Repeatedly complete the seven upper drops to advance their award ladder and eventually light Special at the central red targets.
input.summary: Favor the four lower drops and captive-ball lane for the most direct Extra Ball route. Use the central targets whenever their moving light offers a bonus multiplier, then work the seven upper drops in complete cycles toward Special.

quickInfo.name: Light the bumpers
quickInfo.summary: Complete each colored pair in the four-target lower bank.

quickInfo.name: Raise Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: Hit the central targets when 3x, 4x, or 5x is lit.

quickInfo.name: Light central Special
quickInfo.summary: Keep completing the seven upper drops until their final award tier.

steps.text: Complete both colored pairs in the four-target lower bank to light the red and blue bumpers and two captive-ball lane lights.
Pass all installed captive-ball switches to collect Extra Ball.
Hit the central targets as their light advances; collect 3x, 4x, or 5x to raise the end-of-ball bonus multiplier.
Complete all seven upper drops as a bank, then repeat complete-bank cycles until their final tier lights Special at the central red targets.

alternatives.title: A-B-C-D-E-F lane award
alternatives.when: Use this when the letter switches are safer than finishing another target-bank cycle.

steps.text: Light A, B, C, D, E, and F around the playfield.
Roll through the lower-right lane to collect 100,000 points.
Return to the lower drop bank or central multiplier targets after the lane collect.

buildsToward.title: Extra Ball, higher Bonus X, and Special

steps.text: Complete the lower drop-target pairs to light the bumpers and captive-ball lane lights.
Pass every installed captive-ball switch for Extra Ball.
Use the central targets to raise Bonus X to 3x, 4x, or 5x.
Repeat full seven-target upper-bank completions until the central red targets light for Special.

machineSetup: Test all seven upper drops, all four lower drops, the central targets and moving-value lamps, both pop bumpers, the kickout hole, the A-B-C-D-E-F switches, the lower-right lane, and the captive-ball lane switches and lamps.

Confirm whether the captive-ball lane uses three or four switches, whether Extra Ball and Special award a ball, replay, or points, and whether target progress carries between balls before choosing a route.

playfieldReferences.label: Seven-target upper bank
playfieldReferences.description: Upper drop-target bank whose repeated full completions advance toward Special at the central red targets.

playfieldReferences.label: Four-target lower bank
playfieldReferences.description: Two colored target pairs that raise awards and light the red and blue bumpers.

playfieldReferences.label: Central multiplier targets
playfieldReferences.description: Targets that advance a moving value through points, 3x, 4x, 5x, and alternating outlane Special.

playfieldReferences.label: Captive-ball lane
playfieldReferences.description: Upper-left lane whose installed switches award Extra Ball when all are passed.

playfieldReferences.label: Kickout hole
playfieldReferences.description: Upper-left eject hole that advances its award and can light Special at the captive-ball lane.

playfieldReferences.label: Lower-right 100,000 lane
playfieldReferences.description: Lane that collects 100,000 after A-B-C-D-E-F is completed.

cautions.issue: The captive-ball lane can be set for three or four switches, and award conversions are operator-adjustable.
cautions.response: Count the installed captive-ball switches and read the Extra Ball and Special lamps before play; follow the same physical route even when an award is converted.
